commerce_quotes_cart_check.name: commerce_quotes_cart_check
commerce_quotes_cart_check.value: ("commerce_checkout_quotes"."cart_id" is null and "commerce_checkout_quotes"."cart_version" is null) or ("commerce_checkout_quotes"."cart_id" is not null and "commerce_checkout_quotes"."cart_version" is not null and "commerce_checkout_quotes"."cart_version" >= 0)

commerce_collection_decisions_responsibi.name: commerce_collection_decisions_responsibility_check
commerce_collection_decisions_responsibi.value: "commerce_collection_decisions"."kind" in ('resolution', 'responsibility_correction') and ("commerce_collection_decisions"."responsible_carrier_id" is null or "commerce_collection_decisions"."party" = 'carrier') and ("commerce_collection_decisions"."supersedes_decision_id" is null or ("commerce_collection_decisions"."supersedes_decision_id" <> "commerce_collection_decisions"."id" and "commerce_collection_decisions"."party" = 'carrier' and "commerce_collection_decisions"."responsible_carrier_id" is not null)) and ("commerce_collection_decisions"."kind" <> 'responsibility_correction' or "commerce_collection_decisions"."supersedes_decision_id" is not null)

commerce_collection_decisions_values_che.name: commerce_collection_decisions_values_check
commerce_collection_decisions_values_che.value: "commerce_collection_decisions"."disposition" in ('debt', 'written_off') and "commerce_collection_decisions"."party" in ('customer', 'carrier') and "commerce_collection_decisions"."amount_vnd" between 1 and 9999999999 and "commerce_collection_decisions"."cash_received_vnd_at_decision" >= 0

commerce_events_actor_check.name: commerce_events_actor_check
commerce_events_actor_check.value: ("commerce_order_events"."actor_type" = 'user' and "commerce_order_events"."actor_user_id" is not null) or ("commerce_order_events"."actor_type" = 'system' and "commerce_order_events"."actor_user_id" is null)

orders_payment_review_due_idx.name: orders_payment_review_due_idx
orders_payment_review_due_idx.where: "orders"."reservation_expires_at" is not null and "orders"."payment_method" = 'bank_transfer' and "orders"."payment_review_escalated_at" is null

orders_payment_deadline_check.name: orders_payment_deadline_check
orders_payment_deadline_check.value: ("orders"."payment_deadline_at" is null and "orders"."payment_review_due_at" is null) or ("orders"."payment_method" = 'bank_transfer' and "orders"."payment_deadline_at" is not null and "orders"."payment_review_due_at" is not null and "orders"."payment_review_due_at" > "orders"."payment_deadline_at")

orders_payment_escalation_check.name: orders_payment_escalation_check
orders_payment_escalation_check.value: "orders"."payment_review_escalated_at" is null or ("orders"."payment_method" = 'bank_transfer' and "orders"."payment_review_due_at" is not null and "orders"."payment_review_escalated_at" >= "orders"."payment_review_due_at")

orders_reservation_check.name: orders_reservation_check
orders_reservation_check.value: "orders"."reservation_expires_at" is null or ("orders"."stock_state" = 'reserved' and ("orders"."status" = 'placed' or ("orders"."status" in ('confirmed', 'packing') and "orders"."payment_method" = 'bank_transfer')))

orders_late_payment_acceptance_check.name: orders_late_payment_acceptance_check
orders_late_payment_acceptance_check.value: ("orders"."late_payment_accepted_at" is null and "orders"."late_payment_accepted_by" is null and "orders"."late_payment_accepted_fingerprint" is null) or ("orders"."payment_method" = 'bank_transfer' and "orders"."payment_deadline_at" is not null and "orders"."late_payment_accepted_at" is not null and "orders"."late_payment_accepted_at" >= "orders"."payment_deadline_at" and "orders"."late_payment_accepted_by" is not null and "orders"."late_payment_accepted_fingerprint" is not null and "orders"."late_payment_accepted_fingerprint" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')

orders_collection_attempts_check.name: orders_collection_attempts_check
orders_collection_attempts_check.value: "orders"."collection_failure_count" between 0 and 3 and ("orders"."collection_failure_count" = 0 or ("orders"."payment_method" = 'cod' and "orders"."collection_issue_reason" is not null))

orders_payment_review_check.name: orders_payment_review_check
orders_payment_review_check.value: "orders"."payment_review_required_at" is null or ("orders"."payment_method" = 'bank_transfer' and "orders"."reservation_expires_at" is not null and "orders"."stock_state" = 'reserved')

orders_carrier_collection_check.name: orders_carrier_collection_check
orders_carrier_collection_check.value: "orders"."carrier_collection_failure_count" between 0 and 3 and "orders"."carrier_collection_resolution" in ('open', 'debt', 'written_off', 'collected') and ("orders"."carrier_collection_failure_count" = 0 or "orders"."carrier_collection_issue_reason" is not null) and ("orders"."payment_method" = 'cod' or ("orders"."carrier_collection_failure_count" = 0 and "orders"."carrier_collection_resolution" = 'open'))

orders_lifecycle_check.name: orders_lifecycle_check
orders_lifecycle_check.value:
("orders"."status" in ('placed', 'confirmed', 'packing') and "orders"."stock_state" = 'reserved' and "orders"."delivered_at" is null and "orders"."completed_at" is null and "orders"."cancelled_at" is null)
    or ("orders"."status" = 'shipped' and "orders"."stock_state" = 'committed' and "orders"."delivered_at" is null and "orders"."completed_at" is null and "orders"."cancelled_at" is null)
    or ("orders"."status" = 'delivered' and "orders"."stock_state" = 'committed' and "orders"."delivered_at" is not null and "orders"."completed_at" is null and "orders"."cancelled_at" is null)
    or ("orders"."status" = 'completed' and "orders"."stock_state" = 'committed' and "orders"."delivered_at" is not null and "orders"."completed_at" is not null and "orders"."completed_at" >= "orders"."delivered_at" and "orders"."cancelled_at" is null)
    or ("orders"."status" = 'cancelled' and "orders"."stock_state" = 'released' and "orders"."cancelled_at" is not null and "orders"."cancellation_reason" is not null and "orders"."completed_at" is null)

commerce_payment_allocations_purpose_che.name: commerce_payment_allocations_purpose_check
commerce_payment_allocations_purpose_che.value: ("commerce_payment_allocations"."purpose" = 'payment' and "commerce_payment_allocations"."review_id" is null) or ("commerce_payment_allocations"."purpose" = 'refund_recovery' and "commerce_payment_allocations"."review_id" is not null and "commerce_payment_allocations"."cod_collection_id" is null)

commerce_payment_balance_reviews_values_.name: commerce_payment_balance_reviews_values_check
commerce_payment_balance_reviews_values_.value: "commerce_payment_balance_reviews"."revision" >= 1 and "commerce_payment_balance_reviews"."discrepancy_vnd" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and "commerce_payment_balance_reviews"."purchase_shortfall_vnd" between 0 and "commerce_payment_balance_reviews"."discrepancy_vnd" and "commerce_payment_balance_reviews"."approved_amount_vnd" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and "commerce_payment_balance_reviews"."recovered_vnd_at_decision" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and "commerce_payment_balance_reviews"."paid_vnd_at_decision" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and "commerce_payment_balance_reviews"."status" in ('needs_review', 'debt', 'written_off', 'resolved') and ("commerce_payment_balance_reviews"."disposition" is null or "commerce_payment_balance_reviews"."disposition" in ('debt', 'written_off')) and (("commerce_payment_balance_reviews"."disposition" is null and "commerce_payment_balance_reviews"."approved_amount_vnd" = 0 and "commerce_payment_balance_reviews"."recovered_vnd_at_decision" = 0 and "commerce_payment_balance_reviews"."paid_vnd_at_decision" = 0) or ("commerce_payment_balance_reviews"."disposition" is not null and "commerce_payment_balance_reviews"."approved_amount_vnd" > 0))

commerce_payment_balance_reviews_fulfill.name: commerce_payment_balance_reviews_fulfillment_check
commerce_payment_balance_reviews_fulfill.value: not "commerce_payment_balance_reviews"."allow_fulfillment" or ("commerce_payment_balance_reviews"."disposition" is not null and "commerce_payment_balance_reviews"."disposition" = 'written_off' and "commerce_payment_balance_reviews"."status" in ('written_off', 'needs_review'))

commerce_payment_classifications_source_.name: commerce_payment_classifications_source_check
commerce_payment_classifications_source_.value: ("commerce_payment_classifications"."source" = 'customer' and "commerce_payment_classifications"."cod_collection_id" is null) or ("commerce_payment_classifications"."source" = 'carrier' and "commerce_payment_classifications"."cod_collection_id" is not null)

commerce_payments_receipt_identity_check.name: commerce_payments_receipt_identity_check
commerce_payments_receipt_identity_check.value: "commerce_payments"."revision" >= 1 and ("commerce_payments"."receipt_reconciliation_required" or "commerce_payments"."receiving_account_id" is not null) and ("commerce_payments"."duplicate_of_id" is null or ("commerce_payments"."duplicate_of_id" <> "commerce_payments"."id" and not "commerce_payments"."receipt_reconciliation_required"))

commerce_refund_attempts_number_check.name: commerce_refund_attempts_number_check
commerce_refund_attempts_number_check.value: "commerce_refund_attempts"."number" > 0 and (("commerce_refund_attempts"."mode" = 'standard' and "commerce_refund_attempts"."number" <= 3 and "commerce_refund_attempts"."recovery_reason" is null) or ("commerce_refund_attempts"."mode" = 'manual' and "commerce_refund_attempts"."number" > 3 and "commerce_refund_attempts"."recovery_reason" is not null))

commerce_refund_attempts_outcome_check.name: commerce_refund_attempts_outcome_check
commerce_refund_attempts_outcome_check.value: ("commerce_refund_attempts"."status" <> 'settled' or "commerce_refund_attempts"."settled_amount_vnd" = "commerce_refund_attempts"."requested_amount_vnd") and ("commerce_refund_attempts"."status" <> 'failed' or ("commerce_refund_attempts"."settled_amount_vnd" = 0 and "commerce_refund_attempts"."remainder_not_sent_verified")) and ("commerce_refund_attempts"."status" <> 'partially_settled' or ("commerce_refund_attempts"."settled_amount_vnd" > 0 and "commerce_refund_attempts"."settled_amount_vnd" < "commerce_refund_attempts"."requested_amount_vnd"))

commerce_refund_settlements_exception_ch.name: commerce_refund_settlements_exception_check
commerce_refund_settlements_exception_ch.value: "commerce_refund_settlements"."excess_amount_vnd" between 0 and "commerce_refund_settlements"."amount_vnd" and (("commerce_refund_settlements"."excess_amount_vnd" = 0 and "commerce_refund_settlements"."exception_evidence_reference" is null and "commerce_refund_settlements"."exception_reason" is null) or ("commerce_refund_settlements"."excess_amount_vnd" > 0 and "commerce_refund_settlements"."attempt_id" is not null and "commerce_refund_settlements"."exception_evidence_reference" is not null and length(trim("commerce_refund_settlements"."exception_evidence_reference")) > 0 and "commerce_refund_settlements"."exception_reason" is not null and length(trim("commerce_refund_settlements"."exception_reason")) > 0))

commerce_refunds_money_check.name: commerce_refunds_money_check
commerce_refunds_money_check.value: "commerce_refunds"."amount_vnd" between 1 and 9999999999 and ("commerce_refunds"."original_amount_vnd" is null or "commerce_refunds"."original_amount_vnd" between 1 and 9999999999)

commerce_refunds_settled_check.name: commerce_refunds_settled_check
commerce_refunds_settled_check.value: ("commerce_refunds"."status" = 'settled' and "commerce_refunds"."settlement_reference" is not null and "commerce_refunds"."settled_at" is not null and "commerce_refunds"."settled_by" is not null and "commerce_refunds"."settlement_method" is not null) or ("commerce_refunds"."status" <> 'settled' and "commerce_refunds"."settlement_reference" is null and "commerce_refunds"."settled_at" is null and "commerce_refunds"."settled_by" is null and "commerce_refunds"."settlement_method" is null)

commerce_return_lines_quantities_check.name: commerce_return_lines_quantities_check
commerce_return_lines_quantities_check.value: "commerce_return_lines"."quantity" between 1 and 99 and "commerce_return_lines"."received_quantity" between 0 and "commerce_return_lines"."quantity" and "commerce_return_lines"."restocked_quantity" between 0 and "commerce_return_lines"."received_quantity"

commerce_shipments_lifecycle_check.name: commerce_shipments_lifecycle_check
commerce_shipments_lifecycle_check.value:
("commerce_shipments"."status" in ('in_transit', 'delivery_failed') and "commerce_shipments"."delivered_at" is null and "commerce_shipments"."returned_at" is null)
      or ("commerce_shipments"."status" = 'delivered' and "commerce_shipments"."delivered_at" is not null and "commerce_shipments"."proof_reference" is not null and "commerce_shipments"."returned_at" is null)
      or ("commerce_shipments"."status" = 'returned' and "commerce_shipments"."returned_at" is not null and "commerce_shipments"."proof_reference" is not null and "commerce_shipments"."delivered_at" is null)

commerce_stock_actor_check.name: commerce_stock_actor_check
commerce_stock_actor_check.value: ("commerce_stock_movements"."actor_type" = 'user' and "commerce_stock_movements"."actor_user_id" is not null) or ("commerce_stock_movements"."actor_type" = 'system' and "commerce_stock_movements"."actor_user_id" is null)

commerce_stock_values_check.name: commerce_stock_values_check
commerce_stock_values_check.value:
("commerce_stock_movements"."kind" = 'adjustment' and "commerce_stock_movements"."on_hand_delta" <> 0 and "commerce_stock_movements"."reserved_delta" = 0)
    or ("commerce_stock_movements"."kind" = 'reserve' and "commerce_stock_movements"."on_hand_delta" = 0 and "commerce_stock_movements"."reserved_delta" > 0 and "commerce_stock_movements"."order_id" is not null)
    or ("commerce_stock_movements"."kind" = 'release' and "commerce_stock_movements"."on_hand_delta" = 0 and "commerce_stock_movements"."reserved_delta" < 0 and "commerce_stock_movements"."order_id" is not null)
    or ("commerce_stock_movements"."kind" = 'ship' and "commerce_stock_movements"."on_hand_delta" < 0 and "commerce_stock_movements"."on_hand_delta" = "commerce_stock_movements"."reserved_delta" and "commerce_stock_movements"."order_id" is not null)
    or ("commerce_stock_movements"."kind" = 'return' and "commerce_stock_movements"."on_hand_delta" > 0 and "commerce_stock_movements"."reserved_delta" = 0 and "commerce_stock_movements"."order_id" is not null)
